steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. A contractor on site needs a current induction and competence record.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 2 contractors fail the induction or competence check

findings.title: Contractor on site with no induction
findings.fix: Stop the contractor until the induction is done

findings.title: Competence record expired
findings.fix: Renew the competence record before the next shift

findings.title: Finding open past its due date
findings.fix: Escalate the finding to the contractor's manager

outcome.notChecked: Whether the contractor follows the induction in practice.

pros: Checks a contractor on site with no induction, a competence record that has expired, and a finding open past its due date.
cons: Not checked: Whether the contractor follows the induction in practice.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ehs-contractor-safety skill on the records for this review.
